meta.name: it-asset-management
meta.description: Tracks hardware and software assets through their life — procurement, ownership, licensing, refresh, and disposal. Use this to build an asset register, prepare for a software audit, plan a refresh cycle, control license spend, or dispose of equipment safely.

copy.tagline: 登记并跟踪IT设备与软件许可的全过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果公司需要系统管理硬件软件资产,并随时了解使用和更新情况
copy.tagline_en: Track hardware and software assets from purchase to disposal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage every device and license in your organization

howto.what: Claude会帮你建立和维护IT资产登记册,把网络上实际发现的设备与采购、财务记录对账,列出差异清单;为每项资产指定负责人并跟踪其状态,核对软件许可与实际安装使用,规划设备更新,并确保处置设备时有销毁或擦除证明。
howto.when: 当用户要求建立资产登记册、准备软件审计或规划设备更新周期等IT资产管理任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把网络发现的设备和采购记录对账,列出差异清单
say.note: Claude会对照两边,标出缺失和未知设备。

say.text: 查一下哪些软件许可没被实际使用,可以回收
say.note: Claude会比对授权、安装和使用数据,给出可回收清单。

say.text: 这批旧硬盘要处置,请安排认证销毁并保留证书
say.note: Claude会要求销毁证明,并更新资产状态。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps an IT asset register: reconciles network-discovered devices with procurement/finance records and flags gaps. Tracks named ownership and lifecycle state; audits license use; plans refresh; enforces disposal proof.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build an asset register, prepare for a software audit, or plan a refresh cycle — IT asset management tasks.

say_en.text: Reconcile network-discovered devices with our procurement records and list the gaps.
say_en.note: Claude compares both sources and highlights missing or unknown assets.

say_en.text: Check which software licenses are unused and could be reclaimed.
say_en.note: Claude matches entitlements, installs and usage, then suggests reclaims.

say_en.text: Dispose of old drives — require certified destruction and keep the certificate.
say_en.note: Claude enforces evidence and updates asset state.
